# aAIdle

> aAIdle is a daily AI model deduction game.

Agents can retrieve today's Classic game, evaluate guesses, and use the returned comparison clues to solve the game.
The daily answer is never included in the game payload.
Use the returned candidate model IDs exactly when submitting guesses.
Each guess response includes `isCorrect` and field-by-field comparison results.
The game resets at midnight UTC, and the challenge payload includes its `expiresAt` time.

## Agent integration

- [A2A agent card](https://aaidle.com/.well-known/agent-card.json): Discover the A2A JSON-RPC interface and supported game skills
- [OpenAPI contract](https://aaidle.com/openapi.json): Machine-readable contract for the direct REST and A2A endpoints

## How to play through an agent

1. Send an A2A `SendMessage` request to `https://aaidle.com/api/v1/agent/a2a`.
2. Set `jsonrpc` to `2.0`, provide an `id`, and include a `ROLE_USER` message with an `application/json` data part.
3. Retrieve a game with `{"operation":"get_game","category":"llm","difficulty":"normal"}`.
4. The completed task artifact contains `aaidle.game.v1`, including `challenge.id` and the eligible `models` list.
5. Evaluate a model with `{"operation":"submit_guess","challengeId":"<challenge id>","guessedModelId":"<model id>","attemptNumber":1}`.
6. The completed task artifact contains `aaidle.guess-result.v1` with `guess.comparison` and `guess.isCorrect`.

Use `normal` or `challenge` with `llm`, `cv`, `nlp`, `object-detection`, `classical-ml`, or `filters`.
Use `hardcore` only with the `hardcore` category.

## Direct REST API

- [Current Classic game](https://aaidle.com/api/v1/games/classic/llm/normal): Direct endpoint for today's normal LLM game
- [Classic game routes](https://aaidle.com/openapi.json): Direct game retrieval and guess-submission endpoint definitions

## Optional

- [Homepage](https://aaidle.com): Human-facing aAIdle game
- [Privacy policy](https://aaidle.com/privacy/v1): Cookie and data-use information
